column2: Check server cooling fans and room temperature. Contact the infrastructure team immediately.
Check network cables and router connections. Restart the router if required.
Open the password reset portal and follow the verification steps.
Verify software permissions and install the approved application.
Check CPU and memory usage. Close unnecessary applications and restart the system.
Check internet connectivity and email server settings. Restart the email application.
Check printer power and connections. Verify printer drivers and clear pending print jobs.
Verify employee identity and request account unlock from the IT administrator.
